signals.summary: A smaller evergreen thread on enriching indoor cats' lives with supervised outdoor access and 'catios' (screened cat patios). Highly producible — a cat lounging in a screened patio or exploring safely outdoors.
signals.why_now: Two independent outlets frame indoor-cat enrichment as a wellbeing trend: CBC ('Why catios are great for your cat’s well-being', 2478h) and Psychology Today ('Outdoor Access May Benefit Cats, Study Shows', 1278h). Both are old and only two sources back it, so this is a thin, secondary signal rather than a live surge — kept because the theme is evergreen and cleanly producible, but flagged as low-confidence on source support.
